description: This file defines an abstract class 'PrimaryBasedLogViewAdaptor' for constructing log view adaptors based on a primary, supporting log consistency operations such as read, write, and notification handling. It includes methods for managing pending log entries, processing notifications, and coordinating asynchronous worker tasks for primary interactions. The class is generic, supporting different log view, entry, and submission entry types, and is intended for use within the Orleans distributed framework. It also defines a base 'SubmissionEntry' class for queued log submissions.

classes.name: PrimaryBasedLogViewAdaptor
classes.description: An abstract generic class for log view adaptors based on a primary, supporting read/write operations, notifications, and synchronization within Orleans.

classes.name: SubmissionEntry
classes.description: A base class representing a log submission queued for processing, including the log entry, submission timestamp, result promise, and conditional position.

methods.name: InitializeConfirmedView
methods.description: Abstract method to set the initial confirmed view of the log.

methods.name: LastConfirmedView
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the last confirmed global log view.

methods.name: GetConfirmedVersion
methods.description: Abstract method to get the version number of the last confirmed log state.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Abstract method to asynchronously read the latest primary state, with retry logic.

methods.name: WriteAsync
methods.description: Abstract method to apply pending entries to the primary, returning the number of entries written.

methods.name: MakeSubmissionEntry
methods.description: Abstract method to create a submission entry for a given log entry.

methods.name: PreOnActivate
methods.description: Pre-activation hook, sets a flag for initial read.

methods.name: PostOnActivate
methods.description: Post-activation hook, starts worker if needed.

methods.name: PostOnDeactivate
methods.description: Deactivation hook, waits for worker to finish processing.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits a single log entry for processing.

methods.name: SubmitRange
methods.description: Submits a range of log entries.

methods.name: TryAppend
methods.description: Attempts to append a log entry conditionally, returning success status.

methods.name: TryAppendRange
methods.description: Attempts to append multiple log entries conditionally.

methods.name: OnProtocolMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming protocol messages or notifications.

methods.name: EnableStatsCollection
methods.description: Enables collection of internal statistics.

methods.name: DisableStatsCollection
methods.description: Disables statistics collection.

methods.name: GetStats
methods.description: Returns collected statistics.

methods.name: CalculateTentativeState
methods.description: Computes a tentative log view based on confirmed view and pending entries.

methods.name: Work
methods.description: Main background worker performing read/write and notification processing.

methods.name: UpdatePrimary
methods.description: Stores pending log entries to the primary, with retries on conflicts.

methods.name: NotifyViewChanges
methods.description: Updates view change notifications based on current version.

methods.name: Synchronize
methods.description: Forces synchronization with the primary.

methods.name: UnconfirmedSuffix
methods.description: Returns the list of pending, unconfirmed log entries.

methods.name: ConfirmSubmittedEntries
methods.description: Confirms that submitted entries are acknowledged.

methods.name: NotifyPromises
methods.description: Completes the result promises for a number of pending entries.

methods.name: RemoveStaleConditionalUpdates
methods.description: Removes conditional updates that have failed or are stale.
